"""Two-worker Mac CPU canonical PNG pipeline, approved public media only."""
import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
import shlex
import subprocess
import tarfile
import tempfile
import threading
import time
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

from eval.public_video_protocol import REFERENCE_SHA, canonical, decode_frames, sha256, verify_png_frames

BASE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
PROJECT=BASE.parents[1]
REMOTE='/root/autodl-tmp/lite-omnijev/artifacts/public-video-protocol-freeze-001/canonical-mac'
SSH=['ssh','-n','-p','48926','-o','ControlPath=/tmp/omnijev-ssh-%C','root@region-42.seetacloud.com']
SCP=['scp','-P','48926','-o','ControlPath=/tmp/omnijev-ssh-%C']
source=Path('/root/autodl-tmp/lite-omnijev/artifacts/data/research-eval/mvbench/230a2d4fac8900333c61754641c7a13e069ac9c6')
plan=json.loads((BASE/'plan-report.json').read_text())
assert plan['status']=='planned' and plan['rows']==1800 and plan['unique_media']==1606
assert plan['reference_sha256']==REFERENCE_SHA
MODULE=PROJECT/'eval/public_video_protocol.py'
CODE_SHA=sha256(MODULE)
FFMPEG=subprocess.check_output(['ffmpeg','-version'],text=True).splitlines()[0]
PROTOCOL={'reference_sha256':REFERENCE_SHA,'frames':16,'index_formula':'MVBench_4dd8210_16bin_ties_even','canonical_decoder':FFMPEG,'ffmpeg_binary_sha256':sha256(Path('/opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg')),'pixel_format':'rgb24','png_codec':'png pred=mixed compression_level=6 no_resize','code_sha256':CODE_SHA}
PROTOCOL_SHA=hashlib.sha256(canonical(PROTOCOL)).hexdigest()
fetch_lock=threading.Lock()
progress_lock=threading.Lock()
started=time.monotonic()
report={'status':'running','supervisor_pid':os.getpid(),'started_utc':datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),'platform':platform.platform(),'workers':2,'remote_readers':1,'local_temp_limit_bytes':1_000_000_000,'remote_cache_limit_bytes':30_000_000_000,'protocol':PROTOCOL,'protocol_sha256':PROTOCOL_SHA,'completed_media':0,'completed_unique_frames':0,'completed_rows':0,'records':{},'failures':[],'exit_code':None,'gpu_seconds':0}

def save():
 report['elapsed_seconds']=time.monotonic()-started
 target=BASE/'canonical-progress.json';tmp=target.with_suffix('.partial');tmp.write_bytes(canonical(report)+b'\n');tmp.replace(target)

subprocess.run(SSH+[f'cd /root/autodl-tmp/lite-omnijev && mkdir -p {REMOTE}/incoming {REMOTE}/cache'],check=True)
ledger_script="from pathlib import Path;p=Path("+repr(REMOTE+'/ledger.json')+");print(p.read_text() if p.exists() else "+repr('{"bytes":0,"records":{}}')+")"
ledger_result=subprocess.check_output(SSH+['cd /root/autodl-tmp/lite-omnijev && /root/autodl-tmp/envs/media-cpu/bin/python -c '+shlex.quote(ledger_script)],text=True)
ledger=json.loads(ledger_result)
# Resume verifies remote PNG hashes again in the receiver; do not trust a progress counter.

def worker(item):
 media=item['media']; key=hashlib.sha256(media.encode()).hexdigest()
 begin=time.monotonic()
 if media in ledger['records']:
  cached=ledger['records'][media]
  assert cached['code_sha256']==CODE_SHA and cached['protocol_sha256']==PROTOCOL_SHA
  command=f"cd /root/autodl-tmp/lite-omnijev && /root/autodl-tmp/envs/media-cpu/bin/python -c "+shlex.quote("import json,hashlib;from pathlib import Path;p=Path("+repr(REMOTE+'/cache/'+key)+");r=json.loads((p/'record.json').read_text());assert hashlib.file_digest((p/'record.json').open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()=="+repr(cached['record_sha256'])+";assert all(hashlib.file_digest((p/(i+'.png')).open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()==h for i,h in r['png_sha256'].items());print(json.dumps(r))")
  record=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(SSH+[command],text=True,timeout=900))
  return record,{'status':'resumed_remote_hash_verified','cumulative_bytes':ledger['bytes']}
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='canonical-owned-',dir=BASE) as tmp:
  temp=Path(tmp); video=temp/'source.mp4'; png=temp/'png';png.mkdir()
  indices=sorted({i for values in item['row_indices'].values() for i in values})
  raw=len(indices)*item['metadata']['width']*item['metadata']['height']*3
  assert item['source']['bytes']+2*raw+2_000_000<=500_000_000
  location=item['source'];transfer_start=time.monotonic()
  if 'archive' in location:
   script='import zipfile,sys,shutil;z=zipfile.ZipFile('+repr(str(source/location['archive']))+');shutil.copyfileobj(z.open('+repr(location['member'])+'),sys.stdout.buffer,1048576)'
  else:
   script='import sys,shutil;shutil.copyfileobj(open('+repr(location['supplemental_path'])+',"rb"),sys.stdout.buffer,1048576)'
  script+=';import resource,json;print(json.dumps({"maxrss_kib":resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss}),file=sys.stderr)'
  with fetch_lock, video.open('xb') as out:
   receipt=subprocess.run(SSH+['cd /root/autodl-tmp/lite-omnijev && /root/autodl-tmp/envs/media-cpu/bin/python -c '+shlex.quote(script)],stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,check=True,timeout=900)
  transfer_seconds=time.monotonic()-transfer_start
  assert video.stat().st_size==location['bytes'] and sha256(video)==item['source_sha256']
  decode_start=time.monotonic(); hashes=decode_frames(video,indices,item['metadata'],png_cache=png)
  verify_png_frames(png,hashes,item['metadata'])
  decode_seconds=time.monotonic()-decode_start
  png_hashes={str(i):sha256(png/(str(i)+'.png')) for i in indices}
  png_bytes=sum(p.stat().st_size for p in png.glob('*.png'))
  record={'media':media,'source':location,'source_sha256':item['source_sha256'],'metadata':item['metadata'],'row_indices':item['row_indices'],'RGB_sha256':{str(i):h for i,h in hashes.items()},'png_sha256':png_hashes,'png_bytes':png_bytes,'code_sha256':CODE_SHA,'protocol_sha256':PROTOCOL_SHA,'transfer_seconds':transfer_seconds,'decode_and_all_PNG_roundtrip_seconds':decode_seconds,'source_reader':json.loads(receipt.stderr),'local_elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-begin}
  (png/'record.json').write_bytes(canonical(record)+b'\n')
  tar_path=temp/'media.tar'
  with tarfile.open(tar_path,'w') as tar:
   for file in sorted(png.iterdir()):tar.add(file,arcname=file.name,recursive=False)
  assert video.stat().st_size+png_bytes+tar_path.stat().st_size<=500_000_000
  incoming=REMOTE+'/incoming/'+key+'.tar'
  subprocess.run(SCP+[str(tar_path),'root@region-42.seetacloud.com:'+incoming],check=True,timeout=900,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
  command=f'cd /root/autodl-tmp/lite-omnijev && /root/autodl-tmp/envs/media-cpu/bin/python {REMOTE}/upload.py {incoming}'
  uploaded=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(SSH+[command],text=True,timeout=900))
  record['remote_key']=key
  return record,uploaded

save()
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
 futures={pool.submit(worker,item):item['media'] for item in plan['media']}
 for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
  media=futures[future]
  try:
   record,receipt=future.result()
   report['records'][media]={'record':record,'remote_receipt':receipt}
   report['completed_media']+=1;report['completed_unique_frames']+=len(record['RGB_sha256']);report['completed_rows']+=len(record['row_indices'])
  except Exception as error:
   report['failures'].append({'media':media,'error_type':type(error).__name__,'reason':str(error)[:300]})
  save()
report['status']='all_1800_rows_canonical_PNG_verified' if report['completed_media']==1606 and report['completed_rows']==1800 and report['completed_unique_frames']==27997 and not report['failures'] else 'failed'
report['exit_code']=0 if report['status'].startswith('all_') else 1
report['completed_utc']=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat();save()
raise SystemExit(report['exit_code'])

"""Own bounded canonical PNG receiver; never extractall or overwrite media."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import re
import shutil
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

base=Path('/root/autodl-tmp/lite-omnijev/artifacts/public-video-protocol-freeze-001/canonical-mac')
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(base/'cache').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
archive=Path(sys.argv[1]); assert archive.parent == base/'incoming'
assert archive.stat().st_size <= 500_000_000
with (base/'budget.lock').open('a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
 ledger=base/'ledger.json'
 state=json.loads(ledger.read_text()) if ledger.exists() else {'bytes':0,'records':{}}
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='receive-',dir=base) as tmp:
  target=Path(tmp); names=set(); total=0
  with tarfile.open(archive,'r:') as tar:
   for member in tar:
    assert member.isfile() and re.fullmatch(r'(?:[0-9]+\.png|record\.json)',member.name)
    assert member.name not in names and 0<member.size<=64*1024**2 and len(names)<256
    total+=member.size; assert total<=500_000_000
    names.add(member.name)
    with tar.extractfile(member) as inp, (target/member.name).open('xb') as out:
     shutil.copyfileobj(inp,out,1024**2)
  record=json.loads((target/'record.json').read_text())
  key=hashlib.sha256(record['media'].encode()).hexdigest()
  assert names=={'record.json'}|{str(i)+'.png' for i in record['png_sha256']}
  for index,digest in record['png_sha256'].items():
   file=target/(index+'.png')
   assert hashlib.file_digest(file.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()==digest
   file.chmod(0o444)
  (target/'record.json').chmod(0o444)
  dest=base/'cache'/key
  record_sha=hashlib.file_digest((target/'record.json').open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()
  if dest.exists():
   assert hashlib.file_digest((dest/'record.json').open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()==record_sha
   for index,digest in record['png_sha256'].items():
    assert hashlib.file_digest((dest/(index+'.png')).open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()==digest
  else:
   # 1GB remains reserved for at most two bounded incoming TARs and this receiver.
   assert state['bytes']+total<=29_000_000_000
   target.rename(dest)
   state['bytes']+=total
  state['records'][record['media']]={'key':key,'record_sha256':record_sha,'bytes':total,'frames':len(record['png_sha256']),'code_sha256':record['code_sha256'],'protocol_sha256':record['protocol_sha256']}
  partial=ledger.with_suffix('.partial');partial.write_text(json.dumps(state,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n');partial.replace(ledger)
 archive.unlink()
 print(json.dumps({'status':'remote_all_PNG_hash_verified','media':record['media'],'record_sha256':record_sha,'cumulative_bytes':state['bytes'],'frames':len(record['png_sha256'])}))

"""Fixed representative canonical PNG CPU decoder compatibility, no model."""
import hashlib
import json
import platform
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path
from eval.public_video_protocol import decode_frames, sha256

base=Path('/root/autodl-tmp/lite-omnijev/artifacts/public-video-protocol-freeze-001')
plan=json.loads((base/'output/plan-report.json').read_text())
cache=base/'canonical-mac/cache'
selected=[]
for archive in ['star.zip','perception.zip','FunQA_test.zip','sta.zip']:
 group=sorted([m for m in plan['media'] if m['source'].get('archive','star.zip')==archive],key=lambda m:m['media'])
 selected.extend(group[i] for i in [0,len(group)//2,len(group)-1])
selected.extend(m for m in plan['media'] if Path(m['media']).name in ['EDXBD.mp4','K47J5.mp4','ALXUC.mp4'])
started=time.monotonic();records=[]
for media in selected:
 key=hashlib.sha256(media['media'].encode()).hexdigest()
 record=json.loads((cache/key/'record.json').read_text())
 index=sorted(map(int,record['png_sha256']))[-1]
 png=cache/key/(str(index)+'.png')
 assert png.is_file() and not png.is_symlink()
 assert sha256(png)==record['png_sha256'][str(index)]
 stream=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-select_streams','v:0','-show_entries','stream=width,height,pix_fmt,codec_name','-of','json',str(png)],timeout=30))['streams'][0]
 assert stream['codec_name']=='png' and stream['pix_fmt']=='rgb24'
 assert stream['width']==record['metadata']['width'] and stream['height']==record['metadata']['height']
 actual=decode_frames(png,[0],dict(record['metadata'],frames=1))[0]
 assert actual==record['RGB_sha256'][str(index)]
 records.append({'media':media['media'],'index':index,'png_sha256':sha256(png),'RGB_sha256':actual,'width':stream['width'],'height':stream['height'],'exit_code':0})
result={'status':'representative_canonical_PNG_Linux_RGB_matches_Mac','sample_PNGs':len(records),'all_canonical_PNGs_decoded_Linux':False,'every_canonical_PNG_roundtrip_Mac':'see full supervisor report','platform':platform.platform(),'ffmpeg':subprocess.check_output(['ffmpeg','-version'],text=True).splitlines()[0],'cpu_max':Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max').read_text().strip(),'memory_max':Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max').read_text().strip(),'threads':1,'heavy_lock':'/tmp/omnijev-cpu-heavy.lock','records':records,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'exit_code':0,'driver_sha256':sha256(Path(__file__))}
(base/'canonical-remote-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='records'}))

 state=json.loads((base/'canonical-progress.json').read_text())
 if state['status']!='running':break
 time.sleep(30)

 entry=state['records'][row['media']];record=entry['record'];key=hashlib.sha256(row['media'].encode()).hexdigest()
 assert record['row_indices'][str(global_index)]==row['indices'] and len(row['indices'])==16

 rows.append(dict(row, public_row_id=row['task_json_sha256']+':'+str(row['row_index']), source_sha256=record['source_sha256'], fps_rational=record['metadata']['fps_rational'],source_num_frames=record['metadata']['frames'],frames=[{'index':i,'png':'cache/'+key+'/'+str(i)+'.png','png_sha256':record['png_sha256'][str(i)],'RGB24_sha256':record['RGB_sha256'][str(i)]} for i in indices]))

file=base/'canonical-frame-manifest.json';file.write_bytes(canonical(manifest)+b'\n');file.chmod(0o444)

 target=remote+'/canonical-mac/'+destination
 subprocess.run(scp+[str(source),'root@region-42.seetacloud.com:'+target+'.partial'],check=True,timeout=900)
 script="from pathlib import Path;import hashlib;p=Path("+repr(target+'.partial')+");assert hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()=="+repr(sha256(source))+";p.replace("+repr(target)+");Path("+repr(target)+").chmod(0o444)"
 import shlex
 subprocess.run(ssh+['cd /root/autodl-tmp/lite-omnijev && /root/autodl-tmp/envs/media-cpu/bin/python -c '+shlex.quote(script)],check=True,timeout=60)
command='cd '+remote+'/code-v3 && PYTHONPATH="$PWD" flock /tmp/omnijev-cpu-heavy.lock /root/autodl-tmp/envs/media-cpu/bin/python ../remote_probe.py'
probe_result=subprocess.run(ssh+[command],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
(base/'remote-probe.log').write_text(probe_result.stdout+probe_result.stderr)
subprocess.run(scp+['root@region-42.seetacloud.com:'+remote+'/canonical-remote-probe.json',str(base/'canonical-remote-probe.json')],check=True,timeout=60)
subprocess.run(scp+['root@region-42.seetacloud.com:'+remote+'/canonical-mac/ledger.json',str(base/'remote-ledger.json')],check=True,timeout=60)
ledger=json.loads((base/'remote-ledger.json').read_text());assert len(ledger['records'])==1606 and ledger['bytes']<=29_000_000_000
for media,entry in state['records'].items():
 rec=dict(entry['record']);rec.pop('remote_key',None)
 assert hashlib.sha256(canonical(rec)+b'\n').hexdigest()==ledger['records'][media]['record_sha256']
probe=json.loads((base/'canonical-remote-probe.json').read_text());assert probe['exit_code']==0
report_path=project/'reports/public-video-protocol-freeze-001.json';report=json.loads(report_path.read_text())
report['status']='all_1800_rows_1606_media_27997_unique_selected_frames_canonical_PNG_verified'

report['canonical_job']={k:state[k] for k in ['status','supervisor_pid','started_utc','completed_utc','completed_media','completed_rows','completed_unique_frames','elapsed_seconds','protocol','protocol_sha256','workers','remote_readers','local_temp_limit_bytes','remote_cache_limit_bytes','failures','exit_code']}
report['canonical_manifest']={'remote':remote+'/canonical-mac/frame-manifest.json','bytes':file.stat().st_size,'file_sha256':sha256(file),'canonical_JSON_sha256':hashlib.sha256(canonical(manifest)).hexdigest(),'read_only':True,'rows':len(rows),'total_frame_references':len(rows)*16,'unique_media_frame_pairs':27997}
report['reference_manifest']={'remote':remote+'/canonical-mac/source-reference-manifest.json','file_sha256':sha256(ref),'canonical_JSON_sha256':REFERENCE_SHA,'read_only':True}
report['remote_final_ledger']={'bytes':ledger['bytes'],'records':len(ledger['records']),'file_sha256':sha256(base/'remote-ledger.json'),'all_27997_PNG_file_SHA_verified_by_receiver':True,'all_1606_record_SHA_independently_matched_after_completion':True}
report['all_PNG_roundtrip_RGB_verified_Mac']=True
report['remote_representative_PNG_decode']=probe
report['source_stream_observed_maxrss_kib']=max(x['record']['source_reader']['maxrss_kib'] for x in state['records'].values())

"""Final bounded all-PNG hash, RGB-format and dimension audit of owned cache."""
import hashlib
import json
import struct
import time
import zlib
from datetime import UTC,datetime
from pathlib import Path

base=Path('/root/autodl-tmp/lite-omnijev/artifacts/public-video-protocol-freeze-001/canonical-mac')
ledger=json.loads((base/'ledger.json').read_text());assert len(ledger['records'])==1606
started=time.monotonic();count=0;total=0;max_frame=0
for media,entry in ledger['records'].items():
 folder=base/'cache'/entry['key'];raw=(folder/'record.json').read_bytes()
 assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==entry['record_sha256']
 record=json.loads(raw);expected=(record['metadata']['width'],record['metadata']['height'])
 for index,expected_sha in record['png_sha256'].items():
  png=folder/(index+'.png');assert png.is_file() and not png.is_symlink()
  with png.open('rb') as stream:
   head=stream.read(33)
   assert head[:8]==b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n' and head[12:16]==b'IHDR' and head[24:26]==bytes([8,2])
   assert struct.unpack('>I',head[8:12])[0]==13
   assert zlib.crc32(head[12:29])==struct.unpack('>I',head[29:33])[0]
   assert struct.unpack('>II',head[16:24])==expected
   digest=hashlib.sha256(head)
   for chunk in iter(lambda:stream.read(1024**2),b''):digest.update(chunk)
  assert digest.hexdigest()==expected_sha
  count+=1;total+=png.stat().st_size;max_frame=max(max_frame,expected[0]*expected[1]*3)
assert count==27997
result={'status':'all_canonical_PNG_file_SHA_dimensions_and_RGB8_header_verified','media':1606,'PNG_files':count,'PNG_bytes':total,'maximum_RGB_frame_bytes':max_frame,'failed_hashes':0,'failed_dimensions':0,'read_block_limit_bytes':1024**2,'heavy_lock':'/tmp/omnijev-cpu-heavy.lock','decoder_coverage':'All PNGs already fully decoded back to RGB on Mac; this final audit hashes bytes/validates headers, not a second Linux whole-corpus decode.','cpu_max':Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max').read_text().strip(),'memory_max':Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max').read_text().strip(),'completed_utc':datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'exit_code':0,'driver_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(base.parent/'canonical-all-PNG-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result))
